role_check: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['anon','authenticated']) role_name), p AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['pg_read_server_files','pg_write_server_files','pg_execute_server_program','pg_read_all_data','pg_write_all_data','pg_monitor','pg_signal_backend','pg_use_reserved_connections']) privileged_role) SELECT r.role_name,p.privileged_role,pg_has_role(r.role_name,p.privileged_role,'USAGE') effective_usage,pg_has_role(r.role_name,p.privileged_role,'MEMBER') member FROM r CROSS JOIN p

performance_query_receipt.aggregate: SELECT count(*),sum(calls),sum(total_exec_time),max(max_exec_time),sum(shared_blks_hit),sum(shared_blks_read),sum(temp_blks_written),count(*) FILTER (WHERE calls>=10 AND mean_exec_time>100), count(*) FILTER (WHERE calls>=10 AND mean_exec_time>1000) FROM extensions.pg_stat_statements
performance_query_receipt.slow_metadata_only: SELECT calls,mean_exec_time,max_exec_time,total_exec_time,shared_blks_hit,shared_blks_read,temp_blks_written,toplevel FROM extensions.pg_stat_statements WHERE calls>=10 AND mean_exec_time>100 ORDER BY mean_exec_time DESC LIMIT 10
